takeaway: A new check found five fake-repo campaigns in the registry: 248 accounts under borrowed names (AI Manus, the GitHub Copilot app, Gemini access), with stars bought in identical batches. 222 still-ranked clones are now left out. Jane Street's one-skill repo leads the ranking.

findings.heading: Five clone campaigns, 222 repos removed
findings.text: Repo names shared by 15 to 127 owners each, first seen within a week, with 92-100% of members tying another's star count: ai-manus, github-copilot-app, manus-ai, gemini-config-checker, ai-manus2-0. The genuine Simpleyyt/ai-manus was kept.

findings.heading: Jane Street's skill repo is #1
findings.text: janestreet/agent_skills leads the ranking on 8.5k stars gained over 7 days, measured by the radar.

findings.heading: AI in office and 3D tools grows fast
findings.text: dream-num/univer, an SDK for AI-enabled office suites, gained 1,510 stars, to 26,600. A Blender AI assistant and MCP server gained 1,405, to 1,805, with 74 open issues.

findings.heading: Charta Health: revenue 10x in 12 months
findings.text: Announcing its Series B, Charta Health said it has grown its revenue 10x in the last 12 months.

findings.heading: Nov 9 forecast: 0.44, 3 of 15 picks right
findings.text: Rank correlation 0.44 over its own top 100; its top 15 held 3 of the real top 15.

caveats: The clone check flags groups for review; the radar does not remove repos on its own.
Baidu's Q3 results were not out when the radar searched.
Hacker News and npm remain unreachable from the cloud environment.
